item.title: I have a pond and drive my garbage, yet Marion County increased my taxes for stormwater runoff and garbage
item.description: "I have lived here since the 1980's. I don't mind paying my fair share, but taxes have gotten out of hand. Our non-ad valorem taxes went up over $200 this year.
